test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lc_sort_singleton (a Array(LowCardinality(String)), k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0

INSERT INTO lc_sort_singleton SELECT [if(number % 2 = 0, repeat('x', 8192), repeat('y', 8192))], cityHash64(number) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8192
CREATE TABLE lc_sort_pair (a Array(LowCardinality(String)), k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
INSERT INTO lc_sort_pair SELECT arrayResize(a, 2, a[1]), k FROM lc_sort_singleton SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8192
CREATE TABLE lc_sort_tuple (a Array(Tuple(LowCardinality(String))), k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
INSERT INTO lc_sort_tuple SELECT [tuple(a[1])], k FROM lc_sort_singleton SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8192
test.query: SELECT a FROM lc_sort_singleton ORDER BY k SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8192, optimize_read_in_order = 0 FORMAT Null
